title: Death Note
subtitle: When being right becomes dangerous
_guide_hero: Layout: Title (1-4 words), jpTitle (1-3 words), subtitle (3-6 words). Poster is right split image (2:3 portrait).

entry._guide: Layout: Centered giant text. Limit 15-40 words.
entry.breathQuote: I wanted to see a genius outsmart the world. I ended up watching how easily a sense of justice rots into absolute ego.

reflection._guide: Layout: Right column split. Quote: 20-50 words. Tags: 2-4 items. Cards: 30-70 words.
reflection.quote: It forced me to ask a question I didn't want to: If I had absolute power and anonymity, how long before my morality became an excuse for my arrogance?
reflection.whatIKept: Intelligence without empathy is just a highly efficient mechanism for cruelty.
reflection.definingScene: Light laughing at Raye Penber's death. It wasn't about justice anymore — it was the thrill of outsmarting someone. The mask slipped.
reflection.whoItMadeMeThinkAbout: The moments I have used 'being right' as an excuse to be unkind.

thoughtCascade.thought: He's cleaning up the world. It makes sense.
Wait — he just killed someone who wasn't a criminal.
He doesn't care about justice. He cares about being God.
His intelligence is his blind spot.

_guide_thoughtCascade: Layout: Left-aligned timeline. Thought: 20-45 words. Micro: 2-5 words.

cinematicMoment._guide: Layout: Full width dark section. Body: 40-80 words. Image: 16:9 landscape.
cinematicMoment.title: The potato chip.
cinematicMoment.body: I'll take a potato chip... and eat it. A high schooler playing god while doing homework and eating a snack. It framed the terrifying banality of ego.

memoryCards._guide: Layout: Hovering glass cards. Question: 5-12 words. Cards: text 30-50 words.
memoryCards.question: What stayed with me after the screen went dark?

cards.title: The Notebook
cards.text: The ultimate tool of unaccountability. A mirror for what we do when we think no one is watching.

cards.title: The Chains
cards.text: L and Light handcuffed together. Two sides of the same obsessive coin.

cards.title: The Clock
cards.text: The warehouse. A man who planned everything except the moment his plan stopped mattering.

altMemories.question: What quietly changed?
altMemories.heading: I stopped trusting absolute certainty.
altMemories.body: Light's downfall wasn't a lack of intelligence. It was certainty so complete that he couldn't imagine a mistake. Doubt is a necessary safety valve for the human mind.
altMemories.caption: Certainty is a trap.

_guide_altMemories: Layout: Alternating split layout. Body: 50-100 words. Image: 1:1 or 4:5.

pullQuote._guide: Layout: Giant dramatic quote. Text: 10-30 words.
pullQuote.text: This world is rotting, and those who are making it rot deserve to die.

timeline._guide: Layout: Center timeline nodes. Body: 30-60 words.

firstImpression.heading: A battle of wits
firstImpression.body: I thought it was a pure intellectual chess match. I rooted for the smartest person in the room.

whatShifted.heading: The rot of the ego
whatShifted.body: I stopped watching a hero clean up the world and started watching a serial killer justify his ego.

whatStayed.heading: The danger of righteousness
whatStayed.body: The most terrible atrocities are committed by people absolutely convinced they are doing the right thing.

items.line: my motives when I feel a strong sense of righteous indignation.
when I prioritize being 'right' over being human.
to maintain a healthy level of self-doubt.

characters.name: Light Yagami
characters.mirror: He challenged my worship of intelligence. A brilliant mind disconnected from a moral compass just builds a more effective monster.

characters.name: L
characters.mirror: He reflected the isolation of obsession. He solved the case and lived a hollow life to do it.

ideas.application: Evil doesn't always look like a monster. Sometimes it looks like a straight-A student with a superiority complex.

continueJourney.because: Because I started treating my own certainty as a warning light instead of a green light.

recommendations.title: Monster
recommendations.reason: A deeper, quieter look at the origin of evil and the choice of compassion.

recommendations.title: Psycho-Pass
recommendations.reason: When the system itself decides who is a criminal.
